appHost.device: Owner-approved non-Ben Mac only, future admission; no device activity performed.

fixtureRequirements.need: Approved DEBUG-only fixture seam in the real app routes, temporary preferences and SwiftData store, deterministic fake names/text/statistics/audio/model/permission states, intercept download/provider/recording/clipboard/external-open/delete effects. No source transcript content or real credentials. Retain production view types/semantics.
fixtureRequirements.reachability: Source compiled helpers/previews may not be reachable through production navigation. Each route must prove runtime reachability; otherwise mark unused/gated and never fabricate a screenshot.
fixtureRequirements.textSizeAX5: AX5 is the requested largest-accessibility fixture condition. macOS has no iOS Settings Dynamic Type slider. After admission, prove actual-host SwiftUI dynamicTypeSize(.accessibility5) fixture and record macOS accessibility text/display settings; flag controls using fixed fonts/sizes that do not respond. Do not label an ordinary scaled screenshot AX5.
fixtureRequirements.disabledAndDestructive: Every applicable case includes real disabled/busy or destructive confirmation state; synthetic fixture cannot bypass production conditional logic. No destructive action against user data.
fixtureRequirements.footerGrowth: Add exact five affected consumer footer expansion cases. Prove measured footer growth, dynamic content clearance and last-row visibility in actual app after layout changes; no fixed-height screenshot surrogate.

requiredArtifacts: before/after actual-app screenshots for each case/variant/state with source commit+dependency pin+fixture hash+macOS version+host recorded
AX hierarchy JSON: role/subrole/name/value/enabled/selected/focused/action list and global+window-relative bounds per control
Interaction receipt: exact source control ID, expected callback/binding, action count, focus traversal and disabled rejection
Geometry report: hit bounds, overlap/clipping, pair consistency and canonical manifest dimensions; reduced motion/increased contrast observations
Contact sheet linking full-resolution originals; no Gallery/ImageRenderer-only substitutes
acceptance: All reachable affected controls expose correct semantic role/name/state and keyboard action; gesture-only entries explicitly tested.
Light/dark/AX5 preserve readable text and fit; fixed fonts/frames must be reported as failures if clipped/unresponsive.
Primary/secondary action pairs use canonical geometry from adopted pinned dependency, with no inner fixed frame overriding height.
Disabled actions cannot fire, confirmations remain one step away, cancel unchanged and undo proven where required; baseline history undo remains known gap.
Menu/picker/field system-host behavior preserved; secure fields never expose fake secret through AX values.
No source-only check, launch attachment or fixture plan is reported as native/device conformance.
